senses.definition: n.pr.m. (he hath given, or a gift; cf. Sab. n.pr. זבדם Hal 168 DHMZMG 1883, 15, זביד DHMEpigr. Denkm. 50 = زُبَيْد; also NH n.pr. זביד)—
a descendant of Judah 1 Ch 2:36, 37.
an Ephraimite 1 Ch 7:21.
one of David’s valiant men 1 Ch 11:41.
one of the murderers of Joash of Judah 2 Ch 24:26 (𝔊 Ζαβελ, Ζαβεθ, Ζαβαθ), called יוֹזָכָר (q.v. sub הוה, יהוה) 2 K 12:22.
name of three returned exiles who had taken strange wives:
